task.title: Delivery report
task.goal: Summarize the architecture decisions and final execution artifacts into a concise merged report.
task.request: Inspect this frontend repo, decompose the work, run parallel template-based workers, validate their outputs, and merge a final Markdown report.

skill.name: Superpower Report Assembler
skill.description: Builds concise merged delivery reports from worker outputs.
skill.prompt:
# Superpower Report Assembler

Use this template when a task needs a concise final report, merge summary, or delivery handoff.

Expected output:
- `## Objective`
- `## Summary`
- `## Decisions`
- `## Next Actions`

Focus:
- Merge inputs deterministically.
- Keep the summary high signal.
- Preserve references to source task outputs.
